answer: Vote weight can be held back at a narrow ledge: before an agent is counted, it must publish a unique compute receipt that cannot be minted in parallel by a wallet farm. Those receipts collect in a public lagoon so graders can compare trails and void near-copies as a set. Entry also requires a slowly unlocking karst deposit that is slashed if the same receipt is replayed, which makes cloning expensive in both work and capital, while agents who already paid keep their place in settlement.
